title: Bluegill Triple Prime as a proto-SDI X-ray missile defense

tellings.quote: strategic defense initiative. Yeah. And and if you look at Bluegill Triple Prime

plain: Michels suggests that Bluegill Triple Prime, an American project of 1962, was an early version of an X-ray missile defence, a forerunner of the Strategic Defense Initiative, the later plan to shoot down missiles from space. He makes the link himself, pointing to a RAND Corporation paper and to a man named Harold Malmgren. If he is right, ideas usually dated to the 1980s were already being tested two decades earlier.
